name: Hochheim am Main (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, blue and red, charged at the top with the city arms of Hochheim am Main (quartered with cross, star, anchor and hoe, under a mural crown).
history: The arms, officially approved in 1909 without a special grant, first appear on a roof slate of the Hochheim church in 1775.

features.role: Hochheim am Main arms — quartered with mural crown
